name: anderson
title: Anderson's theorem
explanation: Requires the Brunn-Minkowski / Prekopa-Leindler machinery for convex bodies plus a layer-cake decomposition of the unimodal integrand.

name: apery
title: Irrationality of zeta(3)
explanation: Apery's proof needs delicately constructed integer-recurrence sequences and sharp asymptotic/divisibility estimates to force irrationality.

name: aztecDiamond_tiling
title: Aztec Diamond theorem
explanation: Counting domino tilings exactly requires domino-shuffling or non-intersecting lattice-path (Lindstrom-Gessel-Viennot) bijections not seen in undergraduate combinatorics.

name: banach_mazur
title: Banach-Mazur theorem
explanation: A standard functional-analysis embedding argument using a dense sequence of functionals from the unit ball of the dual.

name: bauer_fike
title: Bauer-Fike theorem
explanation: Short numerical-linear-algebra estimate bounding eigenvalue perturbation via the condition number of the eigenvector matrix.

name: beckmann_quarles
title: Beckman-Quarles theorem
explanation: A clever rigidity argument showing unit-distance preservation propagates to all distances, via auxiliary point configurations (and valid only in dimension >= 2).

name: SimpleGraph.Subgraph.IsMatching.berge
title: Berge's theorem
explanation: Graph-theoretic argument on symmetric differences of matchings and augmenting paths, slightly beyond standard curriculum.

name: bondy
title: Bondy's theorem
explanation: The linear-algebra (dimension/independence) method over a vector space applied to a set system.

name: borsuk_ulam
title: Borsuk-Ulam theorem
explanation: Needs algebraic-topology degree theory (or equivariant homology) to obstruct an odd map from the sphere avoiding zero.

name: upperBound
title: Brascamp-Lieb upper bound (localised, regularised)
explanation: Research-level multilinear harmonic analysis: heat-flow/induction-on-scales monotonicity for general Brascamp-Lieb data with the technical 'perceptive' regularisation framework.

name: brooks_theorem
title: Brooks' theorem
explanation: Greedy-colouring plus careful case analysis of connectivity and exceptional (complete / odd-cycle) graphs.

name: brun
title: Brun's theorem (twin-prime reciprocals)
explanation: Requires developing Brun's combinatorial sieve and its main-term/error analysis to bound the count of twin primes.

name: brunTitchmarsh
title: Brun-Titchmarsh theorem
explanation: Needs the Selberg upper-bound sieve in arithmetic progressions with explicit handling of the totient and logarithmic main term.

name: EuclideanSpace.volume_pow_add_le
title: Brunn-Minkowski inequality (additive form)
explanation: Measure-theoretic proof via the Hadwiger-Ohmann box induction or a 1-D Prekopa-Leindler bootstrap to n dimensions.

name: EuclideanSpace.volume_pow_mul_le
title: Brunn-Minkowski inequality (multiplicative form)
explanation: Follows from the additive form by an AM-GM/homogeneity rescaling argument once the additive inequality is available.

name: cameron_erdos
title: Cameron-Erdos conjecture
explanation: The O(2^{n/2}) bound on sum-free sets needs Green/Sapozhenko-style container or Fourier-analytic counting machinery.

name: caristi
title: Caristi fixed-point theorem
explanation: A transfinite/Zorn or Ekeland variational-principle argument on a complete metric space; short but non-elementary.

name: carlson
title: Carlson's theorem
explanation: Phragmen-Lindelof type growth control of an entire function of exponential type vanishing on the naturals.

name: carmichael
title: Carmichael's theorem (primitive divisors of Lucas sequences)
explanation: Requires cyclotomic-polynomial factorisation of Lucas sequences and careful exclusion of all the small exceptional indices.

name: cartan_brauer_hua
title: Cartan-Brauer-Hua theorem
explanation: Division-ring algebra argument exploiting the conjugation-invariance of a subfield together with additive identities.

name: casorati_weierstrass
title: Casorati-Weierstrass theorem
explanation: Short complex-analysis contradiction argument from the classification of isolated singularities.

name: chen
title: Chen's theorem
explanation: A tour de force of weighted sieve theory (Chen's switching/two-dimensional sieve) showing every large even number is prime plus a product of at most two primes.

name: condorcet_jury_theorem
title: Condorcet's jury theorem
explanation: Monotonicity of the binomial-tail majority probability in the jury size, requiring a careful combinatorial comparison.

name: ae_tendsto_comp_of_ae_tendsto_of_forall_continuousAt
title: Continuous mapping theorem (almost-sure version)
explanation: Mostly a measure-theoretic bookkeeping of almost-sure convergence through a function continuous on a full-measure set.

name: ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_map_of_forall_continuousAt
title: Continuous mapping theorem (in distribution)
explanation: Requires the portmanteau theorem and weak-convergence pushforward arguments handling the discontinuity set.

name: critical_line
title: Critical line theorem (Hardy)
explanation: Hardy's theorem on infinitely many zeros of zeta on the critical line via the functional equation and Hardy's Z-function/theta machinery.

name: SimpleGraph.colorable_of_finitely_colorable
title: De Bruijn-Erdos theorem (graph colouring)
explanation: A compactness argument (Tychonoff / ultrafilters / Zorn) lifting finite k-colourability to the infinite graph.

name: nat_definable_in_rat
title: First-order definability of N in Q
explanation: Julia Robinson's theorem, requiring Hasse-Minkowski local-global theory of quadratic forms to build the defining formula.

name: exists_Ioo_subset_diff_self_of_measure_pos
title: Steinhaus difference-set theorem
explanation: A short Lebesgue-density / convolution-continuity argument; just beyond a first measure-theory course.

name: diller_dress
title: Diller-Dress theorem
explanation: Field-theoretic descent of the Pythagorean property along a finite extension, using quadratic-form/valuation arguments.

name: dilworth
title: Dilworth's theorem
explanation: Min-max duality between chain partitions and antichains, proved by induction or via Konig/Hall matching.

name: erdos_dushnik_miller
title: Erdos-Dushnik-Miller theorem
explanation: Infinite-cardinal partition relation requiring transfinite induction and careful cardinal arithmetic on cliques and independent sets.

name: ErdosGallaiTheorem
title: Erdos-Gallai theorem
explanation: Graphicality criterion for degree sequences, proved via the inductive/exchange (Havel-Hakimi-flavoured) argument with the threshold inequalities.

name: erdos_kac
title: Erdos-Kac theorem
explanation: Probabilistic number theory: the method of moments combined with Mertens estimates and a Brun-sieve error control to prove a CLT for omega(n).

name: farey_riemann_abs
title: Farey sequence / Riemann hypothesis equivalence
explanation: The Franel-Landau equivalence between RH and the L1 discrepancy of Farey fractions, tying Mobius/Mertens estimates to zeta zeros.

name: feit_thompson
title: Feit-Thompson theorem
explanation: The odd-order theorem: a monograph-length proof combining character theory, local group analysis, and generators-and-relations arguments.

name: fifteen_theorem
title: The 15 theorem
explanation: Conway-Schneeberger/Bhargava: representability of all integers reduces to {1,...,15} via escalator lattices and a large finite case analysis of quadratic forms.

name: Ring.krullDimLE_one_of_finite_primeSpectrum
title: Finitely many primes implies dimension <= 1 (Stacks 0ALV)
explanation: Commutative-algebra prime-avoidance/dimension argument exploiting Noetherianness and the finiteness of the spectrum.

name: fitting
title: Fitting's theorem
explanation: Group theory: the product of nilpotent normal subgroups is nilpotent, with the class bound proved via commutator-calculus and the lower central series.

name: frank_wolfe_convergence_rate
title: Convergence rate of Frank-Wolfe
explanation: Convex-optimisation O(1/t) rate via the smoothness/descent lemma and duality-gap induction.

name: Freiman
title: Freiman's theorem
explanation: Additive combinatorics: sets of small doubling lie in bounded-dimension generalized arithmetic progressions, requiring Plunnecke-Ruzsa, Bogolyubov/Fourier, and Ruzsa modelling.

name: friedlander_iwaniec
title: Friedlander-Iwaniec theorem
explanation: Primes of the form a^2+b^4: a landmark requiring the asymptotic sieve for primes and deep bilinear/Type-II sum estimates.

name: Real.countable_not_continuousAt
title: Froda's theorem
explanation: Essentially undergraduate: the jump discontinuities of a monotone function inject into the rationals, hence are countable.

name: Complex.mem_convexHull_roots_of_mem_derivative_roots
title: Gauss-Lucas theorem
explanation: Short argument writing P'/P as a convex combination of pole directions over the roots of P.

name: gelfond_scheider
title: Gelfond-Schneider theorem
explanation: Hilbert's seventh problem: transcendence via an auxiliary-function construction, derivative estimates, and a zero-counting interpolation argument.

name: Nat.Prime.greenTao
title: Green-Tao theorem
explanation: Arbitrarily long arithmetic progressions of primes, via a relative Szemeredi theorem and a pseudorandom (Goldston-Yildirim) majorant for the primes.

name: grushko
title: Grushko's theorem
explanation: Geometric group theory: rank additivity of free products, proved via Stallings foldings on graphs of groups or Nielsen methods.

name: tauberian
title: Hardy-Littlewood Tauberian theorem
explanation: Karamata's elegant proof approximating by polynomials in e^{-y} and a Weierstrass argument to recover the partial sums.

name: HasseBound
title: Hasse's theorem on elliptic curves
explanation: The point-count bound |#E - (q+1)| <= 2 sqrt q, via the Frobenius endomorphism, the dual isogeny, and positivity of the degree quadratic form.

name: Ideal.ufd_iff_height_one_primes_principal
title: UFD iff height-1 primes principal (Stacks 0AFT)
explanation: Commutative algebra: Kaplansky-style characterisation of UFDs through principal height-one primes.

name: hinge_forward
title: Hinge theorem (law of cosines, forward)
explanation: Elementary monotonicity of c^2 = a^2+b^2-2ab cos C in the angle C.

name: hinge_backward
title: Hinge theorem (law of cosines, backward)
explanation: The converse monotonicity, immediate from injectivity of cosine on [0, pi].

name: hinge_iff_geometric
title: Hinge theorem (geometric form)
explanation: Translating the law-of-cosines statement into Euclidean-space angles and distances requires some inner-product geometry setup.

name: hurwitz_approximation
title: Hurwitz's approximation theorem
explanation: Continued-fraction / Farey-mediant argument giving infinitely many approximations within 1/(sqrt5 q^2).

name: Module.End.inv_eigenvalue_iff
title: Inverse eigenvalue theorem
explanation: Essentially a one-line module/linear-algebra manipulation relating eigenvalues of an automorphism and its inverse.

name: jacobi
title: Jacobi's four-square theorem
explanation: The r_4(n)=8 sigma*(n) formula via theta functions / modular forms of weight 2 (or an involved elementary lattice argument).

name: Jacobson_Morozov
title: Jacobson-Morozov theorem
explanation: Lie theory: completing a nilpotent element to an sl_2-triple, requiring representation theory of sl_2 and cohomological/vanishing arguments in semisimple Lie algebras.

name: jones
title: Jones' lemma
explanation: A general-topology cardinality argument bounding a closed discrete subspace of a separable normal space.

name: jordan_schur
title: Jordan-Schur theorem
explanation: Finite subgroups of GL_n(C) have an abelian normal subgroup of bounded index, via Jordan's eigenvalue-gap and commutator-shrinking arguments.

name: exists_generator_of_minpoly_with_some_zero_coeffs
title: Joubert's theorem
explanation: Degree-6 separable extensions admit a generator with a sextic minimal polynomial in reduced form, via invariant theory / resolvent manipulations.

name: kaplansky_two
title: Kaplansky's theorem on quadratic forms
explanation: Determining representability of primes p = 9 mod 16 by x^2+32y^2 vs x^2+64y^2 needs class field theory / genus theory of binary quadratic forms.

name: koebe
title: Koebe quarter theorem
explanation: Geometric function theory: the area/Bieberbach |a_2| <= 2 bound for schlicht functions yields the 1/4-disc covering.

name: kolmogorov_three_series_necessity
title: Kolmogorov three-series theorem (necessity)
explanation: Requires Kolmogorov's inequality and symmetrisation arguments for sums of independent random variables.

name: kolmogorov_three_series_sufficiency
title: Kolmogorov three-series theorem (sufficiency)
explanation: Uses the Kolmogorov maximal inequality and a martingale/variance bound to get almost-sure convergence of the series.

name: koukoulopoulos_maynard
title: Duffin-Schaeffer conjecture
explanation: The recent Koukoulopoulos-Maynard resolution via the GCD-graph / anatomy-of-integers method and a sophisticated combinatorial weighting.

name: kraft
title: Kraft's inequality
explanation: Constructive coding-theory argument greedily placing codewords in a D-ary tree.

name: KroneckerWeber
title: Kronecker-Weber theorem
explanation: Every abelian extension of Q is cyclotomic, requiring ramification theory, higher ramification groups, and either class field theory or Hilbert's local methods.

name: krull_separation
title: Krull's separation lemma
explanation: A Zorn's-lemma argument producing a prime ideal disjoint from a given multiplicative set.

name: lagrange
title: Lagrange's theorem (number theory)
explanation: A polynomial mod p has at most deg-many roots, by induction using division in the field Z/p.

name: LeCamTheorem
title: Le Cam's theorem
explanation: Poisson approximation with an explicit total-variation bound, via the coupling/Stein-Chen method for sums of independent Bernoullis.

name: Nat.LCM_lower_bound
title: LCM lower bound
explanation: The bound 2^n <= lcm(1..n), proved via the integral/binomial-coefficient trick for central binomial denominators.

name: levitzky_theorem
title: Levitzky's theorem
explanation: Noncommutative ring theory: in a Noetherian ring every nil one-sided ideal is nilpotent, via a minimal-counterexample / annihilator argument.

name: linnik
title: Linnik's theorem
explanation: The least prime in an arithmetic progression is bounded polynomially, requiring the three deep 'Linnik phenomena' on zeros of Dirichlet L-functions (zero-free regions, log-free density, Deuring-Heilbronn repulsion).

name: lukacs_proportion_sum_independence_iff
title: Lukacs's proportion-sum independence theorem
explanation: Characterises the gamma distribution by independence of X/(X+Y) and X+Y, via functional equations on Laplace transforms / characteristic functions.

name: lusin
title: Lusin's theorem
explanation: Measurable functions are continuous off a small set, via Egorov's theorem and Tietze/regularity of Lebesgue measure.

name: mcmillan
title: McMillan's theorem
explanation: Uniquely decodable codes satisfy Kraft's inequality, by the n-th power length-counting argument.

name: mergelyan
title: Mergelyan's theorem
explanation: Uniform polynomial approximation on compacta with connected complement, requiring Vitushkin/Runge constructions and delicate Cauchy-transform estimates.

name: merten_first
title: Mertens' first theorem
explanation: The bound on sum of log p / p, via Chebyshev/Legendre estimates of the factorial's prime factorisation.

name: IsMittagLeffler.mapShortExact
title: Mittag-Leffler exactness of inverse limits
explanation: Homological algebra: the Mittag-Leffler condition makes lim^1 vanish, giving exactness of inverse limits of short exact sequences over a countable poset.

name: mycielski
title: Mycielski's theorem
explanation: The Mycielskian construction iteratively raises chromatic number while preserving triangle-freeness; requires an inductive chromatic-number lower bound.

name: NagellLutz1
title: Nagell-Lutz theorem (integrality of torsion)
explanation: Torsion points of an integral elliptic curve have integer coordinates, via the formal group / p-adic filtration of the curve's points.

name: NagellLutz2
title: Nagell-Lutz theorem (y^2 divides discriminant)
explanation: The divisibility refinement building on the integrality result, via the duplication formula and discriminant analysis.

name: weird_squarefree_infinite
title: Infinitely many weird numbers with non-squarefree odd part
explanation: A specialised number-theoretic construction controlling abundancy and deficiency to manufacture infinitely many weird numbers of the prescribed shape.

name: ore_maximal_hamiltonian_cycle_free_graph
title: Ore's theorem (maximal non-Hamiltonian lemma)
explanation: A short structural lemma on edge-maximal non-Hamiltonian graphs feeding the main Ore argument.

name: ore_theorem
title: Ore's theorem
explanation: The degree-sum Hamiltonicity criterion, via the standard longest-path / crossover argument.

name: picard
title: Little Picard theorem
explanation: A non-constant entire function omits at most one value, requiring the modular lambda function (or Bloch/Schottky) covering-space machinery.

name: polygonal_number_theorem_odd
title: Cauchy's polygonal number theorem (odd case)
explanation: Cauchy's lemma on representing integers by four polygonal numbers, via the three-square theorem and an interval/parity argument on the quadratic form.

name: polygonal_number_theorem_even'
title: Cauchy's polygonal number theorem (even case)
explanation: The even-order companion case, again reducing to Gauss's three-square theorem with a separate Cauchy-lemma range analysis.

name: prekopa_leindler_dim1
title: Prekopa-Leindler inequality (dimension 1)
explanation: The one-dimensional functional Brunn-Minkowski inequality, via a level-set / essential-supremum convolution argument.

name: proth
title: Proth's theorem
explanation: A Pocklington-style primality criterion for Proth numbers using quadratic residues and the order of an element mod n.

name: smallest_period_div
title: Smallest-period divisor identity
explanation: An identity for OEIS sequences tied to multiplicative orders of 2 mod 2n+1, requiring careful manipulation of base-2 periods.

name: ramanujan_nagell
title: Ramanujan-Nagell equation
explanation: Solving 2^n - 7 = x^2 completely, via unique factorisation in Z[(1+sqrt(-7))/2] and a p-adic/linear-forms bounding of solutions.

name: riemann_summation_atbot
title: Riemann rearrangement theorem
explanation: A conditionally convergent real series can be rearranged to diverge to minus infinity, via a greedy positive/negative-block construction.

name: risingsun
title: Rising sun lemma
explanation: The structure of the 'shadow' open set of a continuous function as a disjoint union of intervals with the boundary-value property.

name: robin
title: Robin's theorem
explanation: The RH-equivalent sigma(n) bound, requiring precise asymptotics of the sum-of-divisors function on superabundant numbers and the connection to explicit prime estimates.

name: roth
title: Roth's theorem (Diophantine approximation)
explanation: Algebraic numbers have irrationality measure exactly 2, requiring Roth's multi-variable auxiliary polynomial, the index machinery, and Roth's lemma (Dyson/Schneider style).

name: rouche_capelli
title: Rouche-Capelli theorem
explanation: Solvability of a linear system via equality of coefficient and augmented matrix ranks; essentially undergraduate linear algebra.

name: SchauderFixedPointTheorem
title: Schauder fixed-point theorem
explanation: Extending Brouwer to compact convex sets in locally convex spaces, via finite-dimensional projections / approximation and Brouwer's theorem.

name: schur
title: Schur's theorem
explanation: Monochromatic solutions of x+y=z under finite colourings, a corollary of Ramsey's theorem on complete graphs.

name: sinkhorn_existence
title: Sinkhorn's theorem (existence)
explanation: Diagonal scaling of a positive matrix to doubly stochastic, via a compactness/convex-optimisation (entropy) or fixed-point argument.

name: sinkhorn_uniqueness
title: Sinkhorn's theorem (uniqueness)
explanation: Uniqueness of the scaling up to the natural one-parameter ambiguity, via a convexity / strict-monotonicity argument.

name: starofdavid
title: Star of David theorem
explanation: Equality of two gcd-products of binomial coefficients around a Pascal-triangle hexagon, via prime-by-prime Kummer/valuation analysis.

name: szemeredi
title: Szemeredi's theorem
explanation: Positive-density sets contain arbitrarily long arithmetic progressions: a monumental result via the regularity lemma and combinatorial machinery (or ergodic/Fourier alternatives).

name: szemeredi_trotter
title: Szemeredi-Trotter theorem
explanation: The sharp point-line incidence bound, via the crossing-number inequality (itself needing Euler's formula and a probabilistic deletion argument).

name: totient_lower_bound
title: Lower bound on totient growth
explanation: The Rosser-Schoenfeld-type explicit lower bound for phi(n), requiring Mertens' third theorem with explicit error terms and primorial extremal analysis.

name: tverberg
title: Tverberg's theorem
explanation: Partitioning (d+1)(r-1)+1 points into r parts with intersecting convex hulls, via the Sarkaria tensor trick and the colourful Caratheodory theorem.

name: two_factor_theorem
title: 2-factor theorem (Petersen)
explanation: Decomposing a 2k-regular graph into 2-factors, via an Eulerian orientation and a bipartite König/Hall matching argument.

name: two_ninety_theorem
title: The 290 theorem
explanation: Bhargava-Hanke universality criterion: representing all positive integers reduces to a finite critical set, requiring extensive modular-form/escalation analysis of ternary and quaternary forms.

name: ValuationRing.inter_subfield
title: Valuation ring intersect subfield (Stacks 052L)
explanation: The intersection of a valuation ring with a subfield is again a valuation ring, by a direct check of the valuation-ring dichotomy.

name: vantieghem
title: Vantieghem's theorem
explanation: A primality criterion via a product of (2^k - 1) mod (2^n - 1), proved using cyclotomic/order arguments in (Z/(2^n-1)).

name: von_staudt_clausen
title: Von Staudt-Clausen theorem
explanation: Determines the fractional part of Bernoulli numbers via primes p with (p-1) | 2n, using Bernoulli-number congruences and power sums mod p.

name: waring
title: Waring's problem (existence of g(n))
explanation: Hilbert's theorem that every n has a finite Waring bound, via the Hilbert-Stridsberg polynomial identities (or the Hardy-Littlewood circle method).

name: wolstenholme
title: Wolstenholme's theorem
explanation: The C(2p-1,p-1) = 1 mod p^3 congruence, via harmonic-sum congruences and Bernoulli-number/power-sum manipulations mod p^3.

name: worpitzky3
title: Worpitzky identity (auxiliary recursion)
explanation: An inductive-step identity for Eulerian numbers feeding the main Worpitzky proof.

name: worpitzky
title: Worpitzky identity
explanation: Expressing x^n in the binomial basis with Eulerian-number coefficients, via the recurrence for Eulerian numbers and an induction on n.

name: zsigmondy_theorem
title: Zsigmondy's theorem
explanation: Existence of primitive prime divisors of a^n - b^n, via cyclotomic-polynomial factorisation, lifting-the-exponent, and exclusion of the known exceptions.
